edges.reason: transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the ERC20 transfer
msg.sender becomes the 'from' argument of _transfer through transfer/transferFrom
transfer invokes the private _transfer function
transferFrom invokes the private _transfer function before reducing allowance
recipient parameter of transfer is forwarded to _transfer
from parameter is used for balance checks and bot/cooldown conditions inside _transfer
to parameter is used for pair detection, bot check and cooldown update inside _transfer
amount parameter is validated against zero and _maxTxAmount inside _transfer
block.timestamp is compared against cooldown[to] and used to compute the new deadline
cooldown mapping is read and written by the timestamp-dependent anti-dump check
timestamp-dependent cooldown check gates execution of the swap path inside _transfer
contractTokenBalance local is assigned balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth (external swap) before _tokenTransfer updates balances
_transfer sends ETH to fee wallets within the same transaction as balance updates
swapTokensForEth performs an untrusted external router call with a user-influenced token amount
sendETHToFee forwards contract ETH to external payable addresses
the external swap can re-enter _transfer through ERC20 transfer callbacks before state finalization
ETH transfer to a payable address can re-enter the contract's transfer path
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH, an external call forwarding contract ETH
openTrading calls the Uniswap factory createPair to deploy the trading pair
openTrading adds liquidity with owner() as recipient and enables swaps to the fee wallets

manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract's token balance
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract's ETH balance
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer

normalization_plan.reason: The 'from' parameter is only meaningful as the debited account inside _transfer and should be folded into that function node.
The 'to' parameter is only used for checks and cooldown updates inside _transfer and should be folded into that function node.
The 'amount' parameter is only validated and processed inside _transfer and should be folded into that function node.
The contractTokenBalance local is a temporary computed inside _transfer that feeds the swap/reentrancy path and should be folded into that function node.
The bots_ array parameter exists only to be written into the bots mapping inside setBots and should be folded into that function node.
The loop counter i is a purely local iteration variable of setBots and should be folded into that function node.
The recipient parameter is only forwarded from the public transfer function into _transfer and should be folded into the transfer function node.
